name: Igor
bio: Archetype: Ultimate Spam, Bullet, Family Guy. ⌽ Has max Moxie of 12. Does not gain Ultimate card; instead, consumes 8 Moxie to autocast it at turn end, attacking all enemies. ⌽ Skills and Ultimates inflict [Shrapnel] on hit. Ultimate consumes [Shrapnel] on enemies to deal extra damage. ⌽ Gains [Bullet]s from Skill 2. Based on [Bullet] type count on self, increases the Ultimate Might and primary target damage of the next Ultimate ⌽ Increases Lopera's Crit DMG and allows her Ultimate to distribute both bullet types to the whole team when on the same team as her. ⌽ When teamed with Moldir, both units gain Moxie storage, and Moldir's Ultimate inflicts [Shrapnel] and refunds some Moxie to both units.
